items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Interviewer mentions George Spiel in a list of trades (cigar maker), Interviewee responds about 'he' (Garland) not having other trades, showing no personal interaction or specific relationship with Spiel.

ctx.x: No, no, no, because they went, I think Garland said he went up there in 1912, but it was later than that. See? No, he went up after them, and how he got into this band I don't know, but he started playing with them. No, he didn't go up exactly, I don't know whether he was going to play music or what, but he just went to Chicago.

Seems to me like he told me that too, that he didn't go up there as a musician? No, he just went up there. Did he have any other trade, like for instance Manuel Perez and George Spiel and Dominic was a cigar maker?

No, no, no, he didn't, because most of what he did, he used to work in the office. He didn't have any other trade, like cigar makers or anything? No, no, he didn't, no. See, most of all the fellas were called a Creole guy.
